dct_description_sm: "Entered according to act of Congress in the year 1863 by T. Ditterline in the Clerk's Office of the Dist. Court of the East. Dist. of Pa."

241 U.S. Copyright Office Relief shown by hachures. Shows troop positions of the Union and Confederate forces. "Entered according to act of Congress in the year 1863 by T. Ditterline in the Clerk's Office of the Dist. Court of the East. Dist. of Pa." Folded map was originally attached to inside of back cover of the accompanying text. Accompanied by text: Sketch of the battles of Gettysburg : July 1st, 2d, and 3d, 1863 : with an account of the movements of the respective armies for some days previous thereto : compiled from the personal observation of eye-witnesses of the several battles : accompanied by an explanatory map / by T. Ditterline. 24 p. ; 19 cm. Includes text titled "Remarks". This ed. related to citation no. 331 in CW2 bibliography (NDL). Available also through the Library of Congress Web site as a raster image. LC copy trimmed, torn along fold lines, missing small sections at fold-line crosses, taped on verso along fold lines. LC accompanying text pressed in rice paper, annotated in ink on t.p., missing sections of cover. Original classification of LC text: E475.53.D61. Vault LAC nsk 2020-09-14 update (1 card) CW3
